title: a note answer never takes a patient off the list (ring 0, D-1072)

findings.claim: two models agreeing on a stated note exclusion took the patient off the investigator's list on every path; fixed: review with both quotes and the reason code notes_suggest_not_eligible
NAV's likely-eligible sheet needs every inclusion answered yes, so a note answer (or an unknown) on an inclusion still keeps a patient off that sheet; unchanged, and pinned by a test

on v1 a pair's note not-met is stored final: true (cascade: false), so a patient the coded records exclude also lists that note criterion as a reason on the criteria-not-matched page, as an inclusion's not-met did before
the schema texts of evidence.opinions, affirmed and final still say opinions mean a disagreement and that such an answer may exclude; the texts are the contract lane's
deploy comments, code docstrings and check labels of the end-to-end tools still say a note excludes when both models agree
findings.place: deploy/docker-compose.*.yml, deploy/install.sh, deploy/dgpu48-profile.yaml, tools/e2e_simple.py, tools/public_e2e.py, tools/scenarios.py
